newsitem.title: JAPAN: S'tomo Metal profit seen up 27 pct in 97/98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: S'tomo Metal profit seen up 27 pct in 97/98 - paper.

text.p: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co Ltd is likely to post a parent current profit of 16.5 billion yen in 1997/98, up 27 percent from the expected profit in 1996/97, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday.
The expected growth in profit is due mainly to the yen's decline against the dollar, which improves margins on smelting copper and other non-ferrous metals as well as reduces costs, the paper said.
The weaker yen is expected to boost profit by 2.5 billion yen in the current business year ending in March 1998.
Sales, meanwhile, are likely to rise two percent to about 420 billion yen, the paper said.
A company spokesman said he could not make any official comment on the report.
